post.title: AMD Bounced 11% a Day After Its 17% Crash 📈
post.description:
AMD bounced 11.0% on Friday, Nov 6, a day after falling 17.3%. It's still 8.1% below Wednesday's close.

Friday's big movers:
📈 Ubiquiti (UI) +15.3%, after beating earnings (EPS $5.32 vs $4.17 expected)
📈 Rocket Lab (RKLB) +15.4%
📈 Airbnb (ABNB) +11.7%, after beating earnings (EPS $3.16 vs $2.85 expected)
📉 Axon (AXON) −18.2%, despite beating earnings (EPS $1.72 vs $1.60 expected)
📉 Atlassian (TEAM) −16.2%, despite beating earnings (EPS $1.65 vs $1.19 expected)
📉 Natera (NTRA) −14.6%, after missing earnings (EPS −$0.42 vs −$0.26 expected)

Thursday's crash, two days later (vs Wednesday's close):
📉 Micron (MU) −13.2%
📉 Nvidia (NVDA) −6.7%
📉 Sandisk (SNDK) −19.5%

S&P 500 (SPY): +0.3% · Nasdaq 100 (QQQ): +1.4% · Dow (DIA): −0.4%

Which move would you have traded? Tell me in the comments.
Subscribe for the market's biggest moves every trading day.

Moves use official closing prices. Data: Robinhood. Narrated with an AI voice. Not financial advice.

scenes.say: AMD bounced eleven percent on Friday... one day after it fell seventeen.

Ubiquiti jumped fifteen percent after beating earnings, Rocket Lab fifteen, and Airbnb almost twelve after its report. But Axon fell eighteen, Atlassian sixteen, and Natera almost fifteen, all after their earnings.
scenes.title: BIG MOVES · NOV 6

scenes.say: Zoom out, though. After Thursday's crash, AMD bounced back... but it's still eight percent below where it closed on Wednesday.
And the rest of the chip crash? Micron is still down thirteen percent from Wednesday, Nvidia almost seven, and Sandisk almost twenty.
